title: Minor improvements to database pages and minigames

texts: Added toggles to the individual identity and E.G.O database pages to configure the computed offense/defense level, clashing, and damage values on their skills.

Added rejoin room option in Clash Arena and multiplayer options of both guessers. Rejoining an existing room was always available. This just records the last room you joined and makes it easier to rejoin it. Does not work if the room no longer exists.
In Clash Arena, changed the number of rounds to automatically be reduced if the team size is reduced. Number of rounds is capped at 6 times the team size.
